thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — High error rate + missing traces for tenant=delta-ent in dedicated pool=dedicated-e2. Errors spike at 11:07 UTC, 5xx backlog, traces not appearing in central tracing view. Alert: delta-ent-trace-missing. Paging oncall.

oncall-aaron: acked. Oncall here — looking. Is this only traces missing or logs/metrics too?

tayla-sre: I see metrics coming in for the pool (cpu/RPS) but spans are absent for most requests. Logs for the gateway are present but span IDs are 0 or absent. Likely forwarder -> trace-collector partitioning issue for tenant delta-ent. Possible retention or routing key mismatch after yesterday's shard rebal.

maria-eng-runtime: pulling forwarder metrics now. If the forwarder lost the tenant routing key we won't see spans even though logs exist. Give me access to the forwarder pod logs and the aggregator Kinesis shard mapping.

sam-solutions: Heads-up — delta support reported degraded user-facing latency ~30s for long prompts. They asked if we can do a quick mitigation to restore traceability so they can correlate requests while we fix root cause.

priyanka-eng-platform: tagging platform infra — rebalancers ran last night for dedicated-e2. I'm checking the shard assignments; there was a transient error on assignment update to tenants mapping service at 02:14 UTC.

oncall-aaron: ok plan: 1) triage quick: confirm forwarder->collector mapping for tenant delta-ent 2) if mapping broken, temporarily route delta-ent traces to central-aggregator-2 3) notify delta support with ETA and mitigation steps 4) longer-term rollback of rebalancer or patch.

tlayla-sre: (typo) tayla-sre: quick commands I ran:
```
# check forwarder routing table
kubectl -n infra logs forwarder-agg-0 | grep "routing-key: delta-ent"
# check collector partitions
curl -s http://collector-service/partitions | jq '.partitions[] | select(.tenant=="delta-ent")'
```
Output: no partition present for delta-ent in collector-A. forwarder shows "routing-key: delta-ent" but entries time out when pushing.

maria-eng-runtime: I can push a quick workaround — enable trace-forward-fallback in proxy config to send traces to central-aggregator-2 (cross-region) while we restore partition. Will require a short config update and restart of 1 replica.

oncall-aaron: do it. Please keep downtime minimal. Sam can you draft the message for delta support? Include note that logs available and we are restoring trace routing; we expect traces to reappear within 5-10m after change.

sam-solutions: Draft to delta-support:
"We're aware of missing distributed traces for your tenant in dedicated-e2. Logs and metrics are available; we're routing traces to an alternate aggregator as mitigation. Expect traces to reappear within ~10 minutes. We're prioritizing permanent fix and will update in 30 minutes or when routing is restored. —Redwood SRE"

priyanka-eng-platform: I'm modifying the rebalancer to re-apply tenant assignment for delta-ent after the fallback. If fallback works, I'll run a graceful rebalance to put it back in collector-A.

maria-eng-runtime: applying fallback now. Command:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap trace-proxy-config -p '{"data":{"trace_forward_fallback":"central-aggregator-2"}}'
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/trace-proxy
```

maria-eng-runtime: rollout started, restarting one pod at a time. Watching logs...

maria-eng-runtime: logs show inflight flushes, now pushing to central-aggregator-2. sample log:
```
INFO trace-forwarder: sending batch(tenant=delta-ent, size=112) -> central-aggregator-2
OK 200
```

tayla-sre: I'm now seeing spans reappear in central tracing UI for tenant delta-ent. Correlation IDs are back. P95 tracing latency back to normal for sampled traces.

oncall-aaron: excellent. Sam please post update to delta-support and set expectation around root cause investigation and permanent fix ETA.

sam-solutions: Posted update to delta-support channel. Also created a support ticket with incident id INC-193250. Customer responded: "Thanks, we can correlate now — will monitor and report if anything else." Good.

priyanka-eng-platform: I'm proceeding with re-apply of tenant assignment on rebalancer; will coordinate with maria for safe switchback. If anything looks unstable we'll keep fallback active and iterate.

maria-eng-runtime: after switchback test, I rolled forwarder to glue back to collector-A and validated that central-aggregator-2 still receives duplicates for a short window, then quiets.

tayla-sre: post-mortem notes to collect: rebalancer transient failure at 02:14 UTC, lack of circuit breaker around assignment update, no alert when partition ownership is removed (observability gap). Need runbook update: add synthetic trace heartbeat per-tenant and alert when spans drop while logs/metrics present.

oncall-aaron: handoff @priyanka-eng-platform — you'll lead the follow-up and postmortem. I'll annotate incident and mark for RCA. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

priyanka-eng-platform: ack. I'll own the postmortem and the platform patch.

incident-bot: Incident INC-193250 updated: status=mitigated, severity=sev2, owner=priyanka-eng-platform, channel=incidents. Handoff recorded at 11:17 UTC."
